name: haikei
description: Build and operate AI assistants with the Kei platform: set up and manage organizations, workspaces, data connectors, groups, policies, and users against the Kei API, administer the platform with the kei CLI (login, runtime installations), govern agent tool calls at run time with kei-proxy, stand up and bootstrap customer-hosted runtimes, rotate runtime credentials, connect Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and Cursor to Kei, enforce policy and audit on agent tool calls with the agentware SDK, diagnose Kei runtime installations with the setup doctor, operate Kei's own platform services (deploy, rollback, migrations, signing keys, KeiIdentity* alerts), set up opt-in customer-held encryption of audit tool-call arguments (kei audit, age), and develop the DVL Assistant's ingress security, Teams integration, tool adapters, headless evals, and OpenAI-compatible backend wiring, and resource-oriented API endpoint conventions (AIP-style routes, custom methods, migrations). Includes governed connector skills (discoverable at runtime) and forkable connector skill templates.
